name: ssm:SendCommand with a non-blocking Deny still fires COMPUTE-SESSION-TAKEOVER
note: A Deny on an UNRELATED action does not cover the session action, so the standalone primitive still fires - a deny witness that must NOT read clean.
rationale: The Deny targets s3:GetObject, which does not cover ssm:SendCommand, so the session-takeover primitive is unaffected and still fires. A same-policy Deny only removes the path when it actually covers the session action.
